entryPoints.src/ui/App.tsx: Main app shell, nav, worker management, generation trigger

worker.src/worker/worker.ts: Message handler, dispatches to generator; INIT / GENERATE_SCHEDULE / REARRANGE
worker.src/worker/generator.ts: Core scheduling engine. Semester-split generation, anytime optimization with time-deadline loop, recursive rearrangement with backtracking, multi-attempt best-of; emits per-attempt PROGRESS payloads
worker.src/worker/rearrange.ts: Pure suggestRearrange engine: direct/free-slot move -> eligible teacher swap -> deep blocker displacement cascade (recursive relocate(), unbounded depth, node-budgeted, claimed-slot reservations). resolvePlacement takes maxDepth: edit-mode entry points use 15, generation-time uses unlimited via anytime loop. Edit-mode infeasible drops force-insert the lesson directly (no modal) and the grid analyzer flags resulting conflicts
worker.src/worker/score.ts: Lexicographic multi-objective scoring: completeness > teacher gaps > class gaps > distribution > other penalties

shared.src/shared/types.ts: All data models: School, Teacher, Subject, Room, Group, CurriculumRule, LoadDistribution, Constraint, Lesson, ScheduleResult, SemesterSplit, SemesterSchedules, GenerateSettings (with generationTimeMs, userStopEnabled), ProjectState, computeGroupScheduleConfig(), autoMaxPerDay(), buildMaxDailyByRule(), ProgressPayload, RearrangeMove, RearrangeSuggestion, WorkerMessageType

context.src/ui/context/ProjectContext.tsx: ProjectProvider, useProject hook. All CRUD updates + autosave to IndexedDB

services.src/ui/services/ExportService.ts: PDF/XLSX export with matrix rendering, hidden JSON schedule export
services.src/ui/services/workerPool.ts: Worker pool for parallelized rearrange operations

components.ScheduleViewer.tsx: Schedule grid, stats, filters, modals; view-mode click uses persistent rule+slot lock
components.InlineEditor.tsx: Drag-drop schedule editing (group/teacher modes); drop routes through suggestRearrange with confirm/blocked modals; double-click locks pinned through generation
components.GenerateModal.tsx: Generation settings (attempts, spill passes, generation time, user stop toggle)

schedulingEngine.approach: Anytime optimization with recursive rearrangement and backtracking
schedulingEngine.semesterSplit: Automatic per-rule semester splitting, with FORBID_LESSON override
schedulingEngine.spillover: Unplaced lessons cascade between semesters for fractional rules
schedulingEngine.anytime: Time-deadline loop: keeps BEST_SCHEDULE, returns best when deadline reached; user can stop early via GenerationParams (-1 = unlimited)
schedulingEngine.scoring: Lexicographic multi-objective: completeness > teacher gaps (count + length) > class gaps > distribution > other penalties (src/worker/score.ts)
schedulingEngine.rearrange: suggestRearrange in src/worker/rearrange.ts: (1) direct move when target free, (2) eligible-teacher swap, (3) recursive relocate() displacement chain. Unbounded depth controlled by time/node budget. edit-mode uses maxDepth=15; generation-time uses unlimited via anytime loop. Split/double partners cannot be displaced. Worker pool parallelizes rearrange in edit mode
schedulingEngine.locks: Double-click in ScheduleViewer/InlineEditor pins rule+slot lock through generation; moved lessons never reassigned to substitute teacher
schedulingEngine.progress: Generator emits PROGRESS per attempt (attempt, attempts, bestQuality, pct) and a final 100; App shows progress bar + percent in header
schedulingEngine.autoMaxPerDay: Derived from load distribution: >5 weekly hours -> 2/day, <=5 -> 1/day, doubleLesson keeps pair (2/day). Explicit MAX_DAILY_LESSONS override. Applied in generator, analyzer, ConstraintEditor

completedTasks.title: Generation log modal (installer-style action steps shown while generating)
completedTasks.body: Clicking the progress bar during generation now opens a log modal listing what the generator is doing (like an installer), not just a percent. Worker: adds a LOG WorkerMessageType + GenerationLogEntry type, and the generator emits action lines via emitLog() - setup/mode info, semester-1 & semester-2 placement steps, spill passes, attempt completions with best quality, and a completion/stopped line. workerPool routes LOG to the job's onProgress alongside PROGRESS; runScaled forwards LOG unchanged. UI: App.tsx accumulates LOG entries into state, makes the header progress bar a button ('Generation {progress}% [bar]') that opens a Modal listing the entries with per-level icons/badges (info/step/success/warn), % snapshots, auto-scroll, and a live progress summary. i18n keys generation, generation_log_hint/title/progress/entries/empty, close (en/uk). Tests: new src/test/worker/generationLog.test.ts. Full suite 228 tests / 24 files green; npm run build green.

completedTasks.title: Teacher max groups allowed (co-teaching / supervising several classes at once)
completedTasks.body: Added a numeric maxGroups field to Teacher (default 1) limiting how many groups a teacher can work with in the same time slot, mirroring the existing Room.maxGroups. Generator: replaced the flat teacherBusy set with teacherOccupancy (teacherId-slotKey -> Set<groupId>), so canPlace and slotFreeForSwap now allow a teacher to supervise multiple groups in one slot up to their cap while still rejecting a new group when the cap is reached. Rearrange: SlotOccupancy.teacher became teacherId -> slot -> groupIds, and slotFree + the displacement cascade respect maxGroupsByTeacher. UI: TeacherEditor modal + table column (sortable), CSV import (importTeachersCSV + TeacherEditor.handleImport) reads maxGroups column. i18n keys max_groups_teacher / max_groups_teacher_desc (en/uk). Tests: new src/test/worker/maxTeacherGroups.test.ts (3 cases). Full suite 226 tests / 23 files green; npm run build green.

completedTasks.title: Add -1 Unlimited to all generation params with user-stop support
completedTasks.body: GenerationParams accepts -1 as unlimited for all numeric fields. UserStopEnabled toggle in GenerateModal allows stopping generation early. Worker respects the stop signal and returns best schedule found so far.

completedTasks.title: Unlock max-param ceilings; parallelize rearrange via worker pool
completedTasks.body: Removed artificial ceilings on generation parameters. Added workerPool.ts to parallelize rearrange operations across multiple web workers. Unlock max-param ceilings for attempts/spill passes/optimize passes.

completedTasks.title: v0.3 anytime optimizer with lexicographic scoring and time-deadline generation
completedTasks.body: Replaced fixed-attempt loop with anytime time-deadline optimization. New score.ts implements lexicographic multi-objective scoring (completeness > teacher gaps > class gaps > distribution > penalties). Generator now uses a while(now < deadline) loop that keeps BEST_SCHEDULE and returns the best found when time expires. Recursive rearrangement has unbounded depth controlled by time/node budget.

completedTasks.title: View-mode click uses persistent rule+slot lock; consolidate with editor
completedTasks.body: ScheduleViewer view-mode click now creates persistent rule+slot locks that survive through generation. Consolidated lock logic with InlineEditor so both paths use the same mechanism.

completedTasks.title: Never reassign moved lesson to substitute teacher; add cross-regeneration lock test
completedTasks.body: Locked/moved lessons are never reassigned to substitute teachers during rearrangement. Added cross-regeneration lock persistence test.

completedTasks.title: Single Edit mode with entity filter; double-click lesson locks pinned through generation
completedTasks.body: Consolidated editing into a single Edit mode with entity filter (group/teacher). Double-clicking a lesson in the schedule grid pins a lock that persists through generation.

completedTasks.title: Deep 15-swap rearrange cascade + force-insert fallback in edit mode
completedTasks.body: Removed hard block on drag-drop inserts in edit mode. Drop resolution asks engine for deep rearrangement first: resolvePlacement gained maxDepth (edit-mode pass 15, generation-time stays 1) and recursive relocate() displaces colliding occupants toward a hole, bounded by 12000-node budget. When no rearrangement opens the slot, InlineEditor force-inserts directly via commitFromMoves. Tests: 197/18 green.

completedTasks.title: Worker-side AI rearrangement with edit-mode confirm + fluent progress UI
completedTasks.body: New pure suggestRearrange engine (src/worker/rearrange.ts). REARRANGE/REARRANGE_RESULT worker messages. Generator emits per-attempt PROGRESS. InlineEditor routes drag-drop through engine. GenerateModal exposes optimizePasses. Tests: 187/18 green.

completedTasks.title: Automatic MAX_LESSON_PER_DAY from load distribution
completedTasks.body: autoMaxPerDay() + buildMaxDailyByRule() in types.ts. Effective MAX_DAILY_LESSONS derived automatically. Tests: 175/17 green.
